headline.hi: Tower, Kite, Cloud, Balloon — Sabki height nikaalo!
headline.en: Find heights of Towers, Kites, Clouds, and Balloons!

subtext.hi: Is lesson mein hum different types ke Angle of Elevation problems solve karenge.
subtext.en: In this lesson, we solve different types of Angle of Elevation problems.

text.hi: Is lesson mein hum different types ke Angle of Elevation problems solve karenge. Har problem mein naya concept seekhne milega — jaise two points se elevation, object ki shadow, aur moving observer!
text.en: In this lesson, we solve different types of Angle of Elevation problems. Each problem teaches a new concept — like two points elevation, object's shadow, and moving observer!

content.hi:
Yeh sabse simple type hai. Ground pe ek point se object ka angle of elevation diya hota hai aur distance diya hota hai. Height nikaalni hoti hai.
📐 Formula: tan θ = Height / Distance
📐 Height = Distance × tan θ
📐 Distance = Height / tan θ
🎯 Standard angles (30°, 45°, 60°) hi aate hain exams mein
content.en:
This is the simplest type. The angle of elevation from a point on the ground is given, and the distance is given. We need to find the height.
📐 Formula: tan θ = Height / Distance
📐 Height = Distance × tan θ
📐 Distance = Height / tan θ
🎯 Standard angles (30°, 45°, 60°) appear in exams

content.hi: tan θ = h/d — Yeh formula har elevation problem mein kaam aayega!
content.en: tan θ = h/d — This formula works in every elevation problem!

content.hi:
Jab observer ya object move karta hai, toh angle change hota hai. Is type mein height constant rehti hai.
🚶 Observer tower ki taraf chal raha hai → angle badhta hai
🏃 Observer tower se door ja raha hai → angle ghatta hai
📐 Do alag-alag positions pe tan θ use karo
📐 Height same rehti hai — isliye dono equations se height eliminate kar sakte ho
content.en:
When the observer or object moves, the angle changes. In this type, the height remains constant.
🚶 Observer walking towards tower → angle increases
🏃 Observer walking away from tower → angle decreases
📐 Use tan θ at two different positions
📐 Height remains same — so you can equate both equations

content.hi: 💡 Tip: Height = d₁ tan θ₁ = d₂ tan θ₂. Is relation se unknown nikaal sakte ho!
content.en: 💡 Tip: Height = d₁ tan θ₁ = d₂ tan θ₂. Use this relation to find unknowns!

problem.hi: Ek tower ki shadow 30m lambi hai aur sun ka elevation angle 30° hai. Tower ki height nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: The shadow of a tower is 30m long and the angle of elevation of the sun is 30°. Find the height of the tower. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Shadow = Distance from base. Sun ka angle of elevation = object ka angle of elevation.
steps.en: Shadow = Distance from base. Sun's angle of elevation = object's angle of elevation.

problem.hi: Ek tower ke base se 30m door ek point se tower ka angle of elevation 30° hai. Tower kitna door move karne pe angle of elevation 60° ho jaayega? (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: The angle of elevation of a tower from a point 30m from the base is 30°. How much further should one walk so that the angle of elevation becomes 60°? (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: Ab doosre point pe angle 60° hai. Doosre point ki doori = x
steps.en: At second point, angle is 60°. Let distance = x

steps.hi: ✅ 20m aur door jaane pe angle 60° ho jaayega
steps.en: ✅ Walk 20m further for angle to become 60°

steps.hi: 🎯 Is type mein height pehle nikaal lo, phir doosre point ki doori nikaalo!
steps.en: 🎯 In this type, first find height, then find the second distance!

problem.hi: Ek kite 60m high udi hui hai aur string ka angle of elevation 60° hai. String ki length aur horizontal doori nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: A kite is flying at a height of 60m and the string makes an angle of 60° with the ground. Find the length of the string and the horizontal distance. (√3 = 1.732)

steps.hi: String = Hypotenuse (sin use karo), Horizontal = Base (tan use karo)
steps.en: String = Hypotenuse (use sin), Horizontal = Base (use tan)

problem.en: From the top of a 10m high building, the angle of elevation of a tower is 60° and the angle of depression of the tower's base is 30°. Find the total height of the tower. (√3 = 1.732)

problem.hi: Ek tower ke base se kisi point se angle of elevation 30° hai. 20m aur paas aane pe angle 60° ho jaata hai. Tower ki height nikaalo. (√3 = 1.732)
problem.en: The angle of elevation of a tower from a point is 30°. On walking 20m towards the tower, the angle becomes 60°. Find the height of the tower. (√3 = 1.732)

question.hi: Jab observer object ki taraf move karta hai, toh angle of elevation badhta hai.
question.en: When an observer moves towards an object, the angle of elevation increases.

explanation.hi: Paas aane pe object upar ki taraf lagta hai, isliye angle badhta hai.
explanation.en: As you get closer, the object appears higher, so the angle increases.

notes.hi: Basic: tan θ = Height/Distance → Height = d × tan θ
notes.en: Basic: tan θ = Height/Distance → Height = d × tan θ

notes.hi: Shadow problems: Shadow = Distance, Sun angle = Elevation angle
notes.en: Shadow problems: Shadow = Distance, Sun angle = Elevation angle

notes.hi: Two points: Height same hoti hai → equations equal karo
notes.en: Two points: Height is same → equate equations

notes.hi: Building + Tower: Do triangles banao — depression aur elevation alag-alag
notes.en: Building + Tower: Two triangles — depression and elevation separately

notes.hi: Moving observer: d₁ tan θ₁ = d₂ tan θ₂ use karo
notes.en: Moving observer: d₁ tan θ₁ = d₂ tan θ₂

summary.hi: Elevation angle wale alag-alag problem types — shadow, kite, two points, moving observer — ab clear hain, sabme same tan θ formula use hota hai bas setup alag hota hai.
summary.en: Different elevation-angle problem types — shadow, kite, two points, moving observer — are now clear; they all use the same tan θ formula with different setups.
